hook_patterns.name: Shocking Metaphor
hook_patterns.template: This is [concept] doing [unexpected action] on itself.
hook_patterns.why: Piques immediate curiosity using high-contrast visual imagery.

hook_patterns.name: Hidden Truth
hook_patterns.template: Most people don't realize [surprising tech fact].
hook_patterns.why: Creates an information gap that forces viewers to keep watching.

hook_patterns.name: Crazy Experiment
hook_patterns.template: I ran an experiment where AI [unusual behavior].
hook_patterns.why: Story-driven setup with immediate narrative payoff.

playbook.on_screen_text_style: Bold high-contrast text placed in the top third of the frame.
playbook.caption_formula: Engaging question or summary followed by tech keywords and 2-3 targeted hashtags.
